stats.notes: Confirmed one bug: spikes subtract 500 from the score with no clamp at 0, so the score wraps to 65536-400=65136 (unsigned underflow). Seed 42, [down down right right] gave score 65136 after a coin (+100) and a spike hit. Run 1 (score 0 before the spike) gave 65036, which fits the same wrap. The design says the score never goes below 0. My planned dash test was wrong: the first dash set a cooldown of 5, so dash-right was an ordinary step and did not reach the spike. Not yet checked: whether the HUD shows the same wrapped value, and whether a score of 0 alone (no coin) gives 65036 on a minimal run. The 4-token run is believed minimal: removing any token leaves no spike hit or no path to (3,3).
